governance_note: All rules produce flag_for_review or exclude actions only. No auto-delete. Isolation Forest and Z-score anomaly detection are review flags, not deletion triggers.

gate_actions.reject: Record rejected at intake; not stored; error logged with reason.
gate_actions.exclude: Record stored but excluded from model training and ratio study; exclusion_reason logged.
gate_actions.flag_for_review: Record included but marked review_required=true; human must approve before release.
gate_actions.flag_out_of_window: Record included for spatial reference but excluded from temporal analysis.
gate_actions.warn: Record passes; warning appended to quality_log; no blocking action.
gate_actions.normalise_and_continue: Value normalised in place; original preserved in raw_value field; logged.

rules.name: missing_required_field
rules.description: Required fields: property_id, property_type, transaction_date, transaction_price, land_area_m2
rules.check: any required field is null or empty string
rules.notes: Record cannot enter the pipeline without its anchor fields.

rules.name: duplicate_property_id
rules.description: Same property_id appears more than once in the import batch or already exists in the database
rules.check: property_id count > 1 within batch or matches existing record
rules.notes: Deduplication strategy: keep latest transaction_date; flag earlier as duplicate_candidate. Human review required.

rules.name: near_duplicate_transaction
rules.description: Same (city + district + land_area_m2 ± 5% + transaction_date ± 30 days) appears more than once with different property_ids
rules.notes: Flags potential data entry duplication; not auto-merged.

rules.name: zero_or_negative_price
rules.description: Transaction price is zero, negative, or clearly nominal (< 1000 SAR for any property type)
rules.notes: CRITICAL: Zero price is never imputed. Record is rejected with reason code PRICE_INVALID.

rules.name: zero_or_negative_area
rules.description: Land area or built-up area is zero, negative, or below 0.1 m²
rules.notes: Minimum area 0.1 m² aligned with input_validator._MIN_AREA_SQM.

rules.name: future_transaction_date
rules.description: Transaction date is after the import date
rules.notes: Future-dated records indicate data entry errors. Rejected, not flagged.

rules.name: outside_lookback_window
rules.description: Transaction date is outside the configured analysis window (default 36 months for SA residential)
rules.check: transaction_date < (today - lookback_months) where lookback_months from standard_version config
rules.notes: Lookback window is configurable per property_type and market in standard_version.schema.json. Record retained for spatial context only.

rules.name: coordinates_outside_jurisdiction
rules.description: Coordinates fall outside Saudi Arabia bounding box (lat 16.3–32.2, lon 34.5–55.7)
rules.check: latitude < 16.3 OR latitude > 32.2 OR longitude < 34.5 OR longitude > 55.7
rules.notes: Coordinates outside jurisdiction rejected. City/district used for spatial reference if coordinates absent.

rules.name: partial_coordinates
rules.description: Only one of latitude/longitude is provided
rules.notes: Partial coordinates are unusable. Both required or both null.

rules.name: built_area_exceeds_land_area_beyond_threshold
rules.description: Built-up area exceeds land_area × max_floors_threshold (default: 10 for mixed-use, 4 for residential)
rules.notes: Configurable by property type. Flags implausible GFA-to-plot ratios.

rules.name: rentable_area_exceeds_built_area
rules.notes: Logical constraint: rentable ≤ built. Flag for data correction.

rules.name: price_per_sqm_outlier_isolation_forest
rules.description: Unit price (transaction_price / land_area_m2) flagged as anomaly by Isolation Forest within the same property_type × city stratum
rules.notes: GOVERNANCE: Isolation Forest = review flag ONLY, never auto-delete. Human must approve exclusion. Score logged in quality_record.

rules.name: price_per_sqm_outlier_zscore
rules.description: Unit price Z-score > 3.0 within the same property_type × city stratum
rules.notes: Complementary to QR-012. Both flags can apply to same record. Z-score logged.

rules.name: currency_unit_ambiguity
rules.description: Price value plausible in USD/EGP but not in SAR — possible currency unit mismatch
rules.notes: SA platform is SAR-only. Suspiciously low prices flagged for currency verification. Minimum plausible SAR thresholds configurable by property_type.

rules.name: location_fields_both_missing
rules.description: Both city and coordinates are absent
rules.check: city IS NULL AND (latitude IS NULL OR longitude IS NULL)
rules.notes: GOVERNANCE: Location is NEVER statistically imputed. Record flagged for manual location assignment.

rules.name: non_arms_length_indicator
rules.description: Evidence type is manual_entry or unknown with no source documentation
rules.check: evidence_type IN ('manual_entry', 'unknown') AND source_documentation IS NULL
rules.notes: Non-arms-length transactions should be excluded from ratio studies per IAAO guidance.

city.reason: Location identity cannot be statistically imputed

district.policy: flag_for_review — geocoding from verified coordinates permitted with source log

coordinates.policy: allow_null — documented absence; geocoding from verified address with source log

built_up_area_m2.policy: allow_null for land; flag_for_review for built assets

rentable_area_m2.policy: allow_null — income method marked insufficient_evidence if needed and absent

transaction_price.policy: exclude_from_ratio_study — record retained for spatial context only; NEVER imputed
transaction_price.reason: CRITICAL: price imputation is prohibited under all circumstances

occupancy.policy: allow_null — income method marked insufficient_evidence if needed and absent

combined_flag.notes: Record flagged by both Isolation Forest AND Z-score receives combined_anomaly=true; priority review recommended but still not auto-deleted
